subject: Request: Temporary exclusion for inference safeguards impacting Acme product metadata
messages:
From: Alice Perry <alice.perry@acme-corp.com>
To: michael_grant@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Inference safeguard causing demo-critical failures / request for temporary exclusion

Hi Michael,

We're running into a blocking issue during a customer-facing demo next week. Redwood's structured-output safeguard (the verifier that enforces content rules and invokes tool calls) is surfacing repeated false positives on our product metadata payloads. Those false positives are causing the tool-calling path to fail (payment URL generation) and in some cases the request gets routed to a slower fallback model, pushing latency beyond our SLA for the demo.

I've attached a small set of sample payloads and the verifier logs that show the flags (sample_payloads.csv). Our ask: a narrowly-scoped, temporary exclusion from the safeguard for the route /v1/generate/product_descriptions for the model variant we are on (rwd-model-3b-v2) while we complete remediation. We will accept additional monitoring and a fixed expiry.

Details:
- Affected route: /v1/generate/product_descriptions
- Model: rwd-model-3b-v2 (pinned)
- Frequency: ~0.5% of calls currently flagged, but blocking behavior impacts demo flow
- Desired window: 30 days starting no later than 2027-07-15

We're happy to sign any SLA amendment and provide whatever evidence you need. This is high priority for our launch cadence.

Thanks,
Alice Perry
Head of Product Integrations
Acme Corp

Attachments: sample_payloads.csv (CSV of 12 example requests with verifier flags)
From: michael_grant@redwood.example
To: Alice Perry <alice.perry@acme-corp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.example, ben_carter@redwood.example, grace_oconnor@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inference safeguard causing demo-critical failures / request for temporary exclusion

Alice —

Thanks for the clear reproduction and the sample payloads. I appreciate the urgency. I've looped in Marissa (AM), Ben (Legal), and Grace (Security) so we can get a cross-functional review.

High-level thoughts / next steps from our side:
- We can consider a timeboxed, narrow-scope exclusion but only under strict conditions: exact route + model variant + a single request signature (hash) whitelist.
- Required mitigations: runtime telemetry for every excluded call (audit logs preserved for 90 days), real-time alerts if the excluded traffic exceeds agreed thresholds, and a hard expiry date.
- Proposed short window: 30 days, conditional on continuous monitoring and weekly checkpoints.
- We'll need a lightweight SLA amendment / addendum (DocuSign) and a security checklist completed before flip.

Marissa — can you draft the operational proposal and the DocuSign path?
Ben — legal redlines likely. Please flag any showstoppers (e.g., permanent carve-outs, data residency implications).
Grace — can your team confirm telemetry requirements and whether we need a temporary waiver from automated rate-limiting guardrails?

Alice, if you can confirm the exact model tag and whether any PII is present in those payloads (we saw masked tokens in the CSV, but need confirmation), that will speed review.

I'll coordinate an internal expedited review this week.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Head of Solutions
Redwood Inference

On Mon, Jul 5, 2027 at 09:12 AM Alice Perry <alice.perry@acme-corp.com> wrote:
> We're running into a blocking issue... (see attached)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.example
To: michael_grant@redwood.example, Alice Perry <alice.perry@acme-corp.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.example, grace_oconnor@redwood.example
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inference safeguard causing demo-critical failures / request for temporary exclusion

Hi all —

I've put together a draft operational proposal for a narrow exclusion and attached the PDF (acme_safeguard_exclusion_proposal.pdf). Summary below:

Proposal highlights
- Scope: exclusion applies only to route /v1/generate/product_descriptions and model rwd-model-3b-v2 with request-signature whitelist (we'll share the exact hash set).
- Duration: 30 days (start date to be confirmed; default start 2027-07-15, end 2027-08-14).
- Monitoring: New dashboard tracking excluded-call count, error-rate, and end-to-end latency. Weekly sync and daily automated alerts if excluded calls > 1.0% of total route traffic or if median latency increases by >50ms vs baseline.
- Fallback behavior: if thresholds breached twice in a week, we automatically revert to standard safeguards.
- Documentation: we need Acme to sign the addendum + provide confirmation that sample payloads contain no unmasked PII.

Next actions for Acme:
1) Confirm start date and sign the DocuSign addendum (link included in PDF).
2) Provide the whitelist hashes and confirm no PII in the payloads.

If this looks good, Ben / Grace: please review legal and security items in the attached doc and return redlines by EOD 2027-07-08 so we can hit the proposed window.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Director, Redwood Inference

Attachment: acme_safeguard_exclusion_proposal.pdf
From: ben_carter@redwood.example
To: marissa_cole@redwood.example, michael_grant@redwood.example, Alice Perry <alice.perry@acme-corp.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.example
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2027 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inference safeguard - legal redlines and evidence requests

Marissa / Michael / Alice —

Quick legal note after an initial pass (see attached legal_redlines.docx):
- We're supportive of a timeboxed, narrow exclusion but must tighten language around scope and data handling. Exclusion must be limited to a specific API path, model tag, and explicit hashed-request-signature list; no open-ended text-based exemptions.
- Acme must confirm NO unmasked PII will be transmitted. If any PII is necessary, we need an approved DPA amendment + encryption-at-rest confirmation.
- Audit & retention: Redwood must capture full telemetry for excluded calls and preserve logs for 90 days; Acme can request a sample of those logs for verification.
- Indemnity: we will avoid broad indemnity clauses but require cooperation for incident response.

Operational asks:
- Grace, can we run a 48-hour shadow mode that duplicates the route with the safeguard disabled but still collects flags? That will give us confidence without flipping production.
- Marissa, update the DocuSign draft with the tightened scope and add a 2-business-day rollback notice for Redwood.

If we get the redlines accepted by EOD 2027-07-11, security can greenlight a controlled switch.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: legal_redlines.docx
From: Alice Perry <alice.perry@acme-corp.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.example, michael_grant@redwood.example
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.example, grace_oconnor@redwood.example
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inference safeguard - acceptance of narrow scope and next steps

Michael / Marissa / Ben / Grace —

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the clear asks. Acme confirms:
- The payloads contain no unmasked PII (we've double-checked).
- We accept the tightened scope: exact route + model tag + hashed-request-signature whitelist.
- We agree to the monitoring thresholds and the automatic revert if thresholds are breached.

Procurement has provided a signed purchase order (attached signed_purchase_order.pdf). Please send the final DocuSign SLA amendment and the link to the audit-dashboard. Our preferred start date is 2027-07-15.

Also happy to run the 48-hour shadow mode first if that helps your rollout confidence. Let us know the list of hashes and where to upload them.

Best,
Alice Perry
Head of Product Integrations
Acme Corp

Attachments: signed_purchase_order.pdf
